necessary_context.content: A_k is a best rank-k Frobenius approximation; R dagger is the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse and R dagger R projects onto the row space of the output R. Theorem 1 prints the squared Frobenius relative-error guarantee with success probability at least 2/3 and charges memory in bits.

necessary_context.applies_to: Navigation to the actual communication construction, rather than an unrestricted Oracle Complexity claim
necessary_context.content: Section 2 sets m=ck/epsilon, Alice's matrix A=[I_m,R] with independent uniform entries of R in {minus 1/sqrt(d-m), plus 1/sqrt(d-m)}, and Bob's suffix of k distinct coordinate rows selected uniformly from [m], independently of R. B stacks the prefix and suffix. The printed construction requires c/epsilon>1 and implicitly integral m. Theorem 4 additionally states d>=k/epsilon and sufficiently small positive c. No rounding extension is established here.
necessary_context.name: Communication construction and its window
